description.value: Cliff Gilker Park is a nature reserve managed by the Sunshine Coast Regional District (SCRD) located near Roberts Creek on BC's Sunshine Coast. It is a publicly accessible park listed under the SCRD's parks portfolio. Touring cyclists passing through the Sunshine Coast area may find it a worthwhile natural stop, though specific on-site cycling facilities are unconfirmed from available sources.
